response.description:
Support for PowerShell 7.4 will
end on November 10, 2026, please transition to PowerShell 7.6. Your Azure Function apps will continue to run, but security patches and updates will no
longer be provided and customer support for
PowerShell 7.4 will be discontinued. Running function apps on
unsupported runtime or language version, may lead to issues and degraded
performance.  Required action  To avoid potential security vulnerabilities, minimize risk
for your Azure Functions apps, and take advantage of latest features, follow
the steps to upgrade your app to PowerShell
7.6 before November 10, 2026.  Note: If your app is on a Linux Consumption plan, you will
need to first upgrade to Flex Consumption plan before upgrading to PowerShell
7.6. Learn
more.
response.title: Retirement: Support for PowerShell 7.4 ends on November 10, 2026
